title.narrative: Advocating for Inclusive Digital Transformation, enhanced data governance and AI Capacity Building in Southern Africa

description.narrative: - This workplan seeks to strengthen the capacities of Member States and civil servants to advance inclusive digital transformation, sustainable AI, and data governance through the delivery of the UNESCO “AI and Digital Transformation in Government” training, developed in collaboration with the University of Oxford’s Saïd Business School. -The initiative contributes to the AI for Good Initiative and the AI Skills Coalition by providing accessible, high-quality training to public sector actors, with a focus on developing and Least Developed Countries. It equips civil servants and public sector leaders with the knowledge and tools to address the challenges of artificial intelligence and digital transformation in a responsible and in line with International Human Rights Standards. - UNESCO will also support international digital cooperation through global, regional, and national engagements under the SPAARK Alliance, AI4IA platform, therefore facilitating dialogue on AI and access to information among public institutions, judiciary actors, parliamentarians, academia, civil society, and the private sector.
